profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer & Design Engineer | WebGL/Three.js, Motion & Design Systems | Vanquisher of Boring Websites @ Shopify
profile.summary:
I’m a design engineer and senior frontend developer who turns ambitious creative ideas into polished, memorable web experiences. At Shopify, I lead development of interactive launches using React, WebGL, Three.js, shaders, motion, and design systems.
 
Over 20 years in frontend development, I’ve specialized in the space where design and engineering meet—interactive storytelling, motion, WebGL, Three.js, shaders, generative visuals, design systems, and highly crafted user interfaces.
 
At Shopify, I’ve helped build major global launches including Shopify Editions, working closely with designers, motion artists, writers, and engineers to turn complex concepts into responsive, accessible, production-ready experiences.
 
I’m especially energized by projects that require both technical depth and visual judgment: the work that is too interactive for a traditional designer to build alone and too design-sensitive to hand off without close collaboration. I live for the discovery of new ideas and interactions that occurs during the collaborative process.
 
I’m currently interested in design engineering and creative frontend roles where experimentation, craftsmanship, and clear communication are valued.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Build high-profile interactive experiences for Shopify’s global launches, partnering with designers, motion artists, writers, and engineers from concept through production.
 
• Sole developer for Shopify’s Universal Commerce Protocol launch page, built in 2.5 weeks for its debut at Google’s NRF keynote. Created the WebGL hero, logo animation, accessible fallbacks, and coordinated a zero-issue launch.
 
• Led development of Boring TV, a 3D Winter ’25 Edition Easter egg featuring 188 AI-generated videos, custom CRT shaders, an in-scene interface, and an interactive remote.
 
• Co-led development of Shopify Editions Record Albums, a 3D archive combining baked textures, dynamic shadows, and a custom blur shader for visual fidelity and smooth performance.
 
• Built interactive 3D experiences for Shopify Editions using React Three Fiber, Three.js, GSAP, shaders, and custom animation systems.
positions.insights: Skills: WebGL · React.js · Tailwind CSS · Motion Design · Accessibility

positions.title: Founder & Creative Developer
positions.locationName: Iowa City, Iowa, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Founded and built an independent generative-art apparel brand, owning the experience from visual concept and product design through Shopify development, merchandising, analytics, and marketing. (https://brightfield.studio/)
 
• Designed and developed a custom Shopify storefront focused on expressive interaction with WebGL shaders
 • Created generative artwork and production-ready apparel designs using code and AI-assisted creative tools
 • Implemented e-commerce analytics, conversion tracking, product systems, and iterative UX improvements
 • Developed the brand identity, product presentation, campaign assets, and customer experience end to end
